title: Design System: TinCan Mesh OS (startup shell)

mark.purpose: The TinCan wordmark beside the ring mark.

caption-title.purpose: Bottom-left caption for the playing clip.

launcher-name.purpose: The tool list; the only large type in the shell.

caption-meta.purpose: Creator handle under the clip title.

launcher-desc.purpose: One line beside each tool name.

fine.purpose: Hints, key caps, launcher footer. The size floor.

shadows.name: clip-frame
shadows.purpose: The one object resting on the room.

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: Smoked window pane over the dimmed feed.

shadows.name: caption-legibility
shadows.purpose: Text shadow on floating chrome over the clip (0.7 alpha at 14px on the caption).

shadows.name: backdrop-blur
shadows.purpose: Filter on the blurred copy of the clip behind the frame.

shadows.name: launcher-clip-state
shadows.purpose: Clip frame while the launcher is open.

shadows.name: working-clip-state
shadows.purpose: Clip frame while a window is open (backdrop to 0.55 opacity).

motion.name: zen-ease
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition.

motion.name: state-medium
motion.purpose: Join hover (300), ticks and hint (400), clip fade (420).

motion.name: launcher
motion.purpose: Launcher fade in and out (visibility delayed on close).

motion.name: chrome
motion.purpose: Feed chrome fade and 6px drop when a window or launcher is open; clip drift transform is 620ms.

motion.name: atmosphere
motion.purpose: Backdrop and clip filter changes, mark ring rotation (-24deg on hover).

motion.name: wash-drift
motion.purpose: Slow translate and +/-4deg rotate of the wash.

motion.name: clip-change
motion.value: vertical drift of +/-4% with opacity fade; 380ms lock between changes
motion.purpose: Next or previous clip; backdrop crossfades.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: wash and grain animation none; transitions 1ms

components.name: Mark
components.description: The one permanent control: open ring, persimmon dot, serif wordmark. Opens the launcher.
components.css: .ds-mark{appearance:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.7rem;color:#ece6da;font-family:var(--zen-mincho, 'Shippori Mincho', 'Hiragino Mincho ProN', 'Yu Mincho', serif);font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:0.02em;text-shadow:0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)}.ds-mark svg{transition:transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-mark:hover svg{transform:rotate(-24deg)}.ds-mark:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ece6da;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:6px}

components.name: Clip caption
components.description: Serif title over gothic creator handle, bottom-left of the feed.
components.css: .ds-caption{max-width:30ch;text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);color:#ece6da}.ds-caption-title{margin:0;font-family:var(--zen-mincho, 'Shippori Mincho', 'Hiragino Mincho ProN', 'Yu Mincho', serif);font-weight:500;font-size:1.12rem;line-height:1.35;text-wrap:balance}.ds-caption-meta{margin:0.4rem 0 0;font-family:var(--zen-gothic, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:0.78rem;letter-spacing:0.03em;color:rgba(236,230,218,0.66)}

components.name: Sound toggle
components.description: Text-and-icon toggle with no container; quiet at rest, full washi on hover.
components.css: .ds-sound{appearance:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;color:rgba(236,230,218,0.66);font-family:var(--zen-gothic, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:0.86rem}.ds-sound:hover{color:#ece6da}.ds-sound:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ece6da;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:6px}

components.name: Join button
components.description: The one container in the feed chrome: hairline capsule over a translucent ink fill.
components.css: .ds-join{appearance:none;cursor:pointer;color:#ece6da;font-family:var(--zen-gothic, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:0.86rem;padding:0.55rem 1.05rem;border:1px solid rgba(236,230,218,0.32);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(14,13,11,0.32);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-join:hover{background:rgba(236,230,218,0.12);border-color:rgba(236,230,218,0.55)}.ds-join:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ece6da;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:6px}

components.name: Position ticks
components.description: Hairline bars on the right edge; the current clip grows and turns persimmon.

components.name: Launcher search
components.description: Underline-only field with a persimmon caret and an esc key cap.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input class="ds-search-input" type="text" placeholder="Find a tool" autocomplete="off"><kbd class="ds-key">esc</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(236,230,218,0.14);padding-bottom:0.8rem;transition:border-color 300ms}.ds-search:focus-within{border-bottom-color:rgba(236,230,218,0.42)}.ds-search-input{flex:1;background:transparent;border:0;color:#ece6da;caret-color:#d0703f;font-family:var(--zen-gothic, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:0.95rem;letter-spacing:0.02em}.ds-search-input::placeholder{color:rgba(236,230,218,0.6)}.ds-search-input:focus{outline:none}.ds-key{font-family:var(--zen-gothic, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:0.72rem;color:rgba(236,230,218,0.6);border:1px solid rgba(236,230,218,0.14);border-radius:5px;padding:0.1rem 0.4rem}

components.name: Launcher rows
components.description: Serif tool names beside gothic descriptions; the selected row brightens and gains a persimmon dot.
components.css: .ds-tools{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:#0e0d0b}.ds-row{appearance:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;position:relative;width:100%;text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:15rem 1fr;align-items:baseline;gap:1.25rem;padding:0.5rem 0 0.5rem 1.5rem;color:rgba(236,230,218,0.66);transition:color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-row::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0.2rem;top:50%;width:7px;height:7px;margin-top:-3px;border-radius:50%;background:#d0703f;opacity:0;transform:scale(0.4);transition:opacity 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-row[aria-selected='true']::before{opacity:1;transform:none}.ds-row-name{font-family:var(--zen-mincho, 'Shippori Mincho', 'Hiragino Mincho ProN', 'Yu Mincho', serif);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3.1vw,2.3rem);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-0.01em;white-space:nowrap}.ds-row-desc{font-family:var(--zen-gothic, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Yu Gothic', system-ui, sans-serif);font-size:0.82rem;color:rgba(236,230,218,0.6);transition:color 260ms}.ds-row:hover,.ds-row[aria-selected='true']{color:#ece6da}.ds-row:hover .ds-row-desc,.ds-row[aria-selected='true'] .ds-row-desc{color:rgba(236,230,218,0.66)}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ece6da;outline-offset:4px;border-radius:6px}

components.name: Clip frame
components.description: The 9:16 clip container: 14px radius, hairline ring, one soft ambient shadow. Full-bleed and unrounded on phones.

components.name: Window container
components.description: Smoked pane for a re-dressed classic window. Container only; interiors are known drift.

narrative.overview:
The shell is a dark room with one thing playing in it. A vertical clip sits in the middle, its own blurred image spreads behind it as a backdrop, and a slow, muddy wash of rust, moss, indigo and umber drifts over that backdrop under fine moving grain. Everything the interface adds is paper-white (washi) on ink (sumi): thin hairlines, small type, and a single persimmon accent. The interface is meant to be forgotten until the viewer reaches for it, and the clip is the thing the visitor came for.

Two voices carry the type. A soft Japanese-style serif (Shippori Mincho) names things: the mark, the clip title, the tools. A quiet humanist gothic (Zen Kaku Gothic New) does the small work: metadata, controls, hints, fields. Scale is used sparingly. The only large type in the whole shell is the tool list in the launcher, where a returning peer reads names the way a menu is read.

Depth comes from blur and darkness, not from raised objects. When a tool is called, the launcher deepens the wash and blurs the clip that is still playing behind it. When a window opens, the clip dims and softens and the window floats over it as a smoked, blurred pane with a hairline edge. The shell never fills the screen with chrome; when it has nothing to say, the chrome is invisible.
keyCharacteristics: Ink ground, paper type, one persimmon accent; no second accent.
Muddy, desaturated washes with film grain over a blurred copy of the playing clip.
1px washi hairlines as the only separator and border.
Two typefaces with strict roles: serif names, gothic utilities.
Chrome fades out when a window or the launcher is up, and returns when the feed returns.
Motion is one long ease-out curve, vertical, and slow; reduced-motion stills the wash and grain and shortens every transition to 1ms.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Persimmon marks position and selection and nothing else: where you are in the feed, which tool is selected, where the caret is. It never fills a button, a surface or a heading.

rules.name: The Three Paper Levels Rule
rules.body: Text is washi, washi-quiet or washi-dim. A new surface picks one of the three; it does not invent a fourth transparency or introduce a new hue for text.

rules.name: The Dirty Wash Rule
rules.body: Washes stay muddy and low in saturation, sit behind the clip, and are always closed by a vignette. A clean or saturated gradient is a different world.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The serif names things (brand, clip, tool); the gothic does everything else. Do not set a control, field or paragraph in the serif, and do not set a name in the gothic.

rules.name: The Quiet Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no wide tracking on labels. Hierarchy comes from face, size and the three paper levels.

rules.name: The Recede Rule
rules.body: Feed chrome (caption, sound, Join, ticks) fades to zero and drops 6px while a window or the launcher is open. The mark never fades; it is the way back.

rules.name: The No Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the shell is lifted by an offset shadow. A new element earns separation with a hairline, a blur or a darker ground.

dos: **Do** let the clip be the brightest, most saturated thing on screen; the interface stays in ink and washi.
**Do** use persimmon (#d0703f) only for position, selection and the caret.
**Do** pick text color from washi (#ece6da), washi-quiet (66%) or washi-dim (60%).
**Do** separate with a 1px washi-hairline (14%) or with blur and darkness.
**Do** name things in Shippori Mincho and set utility text in Zen Kaku Gothic New.
**Do** fade feed chrome out when anything modal is open, and return it when the feed returns.
**Do** use the single easing curve `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`; durations of 260-620ms for state, 900ms for atmosphere, and 70s for the wash drift.
**Do** honor reduced motion by stilling the wash and grain and cutting transitions to 1ms.
**Do** keep every tool one gesture away: the mark or Cmd/Ctrl+K, with full keyboard operation.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent color or fill any surface with persimmon.
**Don't** let the washes become clean, bright or saturated, or sit in front of the clip.
**Don't** use a glow, a colored shadow or a hard offset shadow.
**Don't** add a filled or colored pill, a button bar or a dock; the one capsule is the hairline Join.
**Don't** open any window or form over the first clip; nothing opens until asked for.
**Don't** set text below washi-dim or below 0.72rem.
**Don't** use uppercase labels, wide tracking, or emoji in new shell UI.
**Don't** copy the classic interior look (neon cyan, emerald and indigo fills, monospace, gradient call-to-action buttons) into new shell work.
